ENHANCEMENTS

    [*]Updated to Unity 2017;

[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: The Hardest Thing Patch Notes [2/17/18]
notes.notes:
A new update 1.1 is available for [url=store.steampowered.com/app/773510/The_Hardest_Thing/] The Hardest Thing	[/url] now. This update will automatically install when starting the Steam client, if it doesn’t install automatically, please restart Steam.

NEW GAME MECHANICS
[list]
    [*]Added the "Heavy Helium", the exact opposite of the helium.
    [*]Added Group Portals.
    [*]New water mechanics.
[/list]
ENHANCEMENTS
[list]
    [*]Reworked more than 15 final levels.
    [*]Added 6 new levels to rooms 4 and 5.
    [*]Improved some game physics.
[/list]
GENERAL BUG FIXES
[list]
    [*]Fixed bug Helium + Fun interaction.
    [*]Fixed bugs with physics on low-performance computers.
    [*]Fixed some little bugs with water physics.
    [*]Optimization and increase performance.
[/list]
